rows.label: Three courses, each from a different one of the other concentrations' approved lists
rows.note: Foundation courses, independent research, teaching and the first-year introductory cluster do not count here; some other-concentration courses need petition.

rows.label: At least 13 credits of concentration coursework beyond the foundation courses
rows.note: Counts courses on any other concentration's list, never foundation courses. BIOG 4990 counts at 2 or 3 credits (at most 3 toward the 13); CHEM 2510 counts unless it was the organic chemistry lab used for the foundation, which the confirm row checks.

limits.label: Independent research counts for at most 3 credits

rows.label: One biology laboratory or field course (not the excluded labs)
rows.note: Starred courses on the Biodiversity list carry a lab part; PLSCI 2300 counts only with its five-credit option, so it is left to the confirm row. Other labs need advisor approval.

rows.label: Two upper-level courses (3000+, 2 or more credits) from the concentration lists
rows.note: A course may meet this, the lab row and the breadth row at once. Math, statistics and computer science courses on the lists are left out, as is CEE 4510, because the page requires significant biology content; the biology-content row below covers the rest. BIOG 4990 counts here at 2 or more credits.

rows.label: Each of the two upper-level courses has significant biology content
Advisor sign-off and petition for anything outside the lists (lab choice, other biology courses, 4990 research, PLSCI 2300 lab, BIOEE 1610 exception)
Letter grades (unless S/U-only), each D- or better
Organic chemistry course choices can disqualify CHEM 2510 or 3580 from this concentration
